PCG_COPPattern.houdini_notes: Covers Houdini's Checkerboard, Tile Pattern, Cell Pattern, Labs UV Grid Texture, Julia Fractal, Chladni Cymatic Patterns, Knit and Weave. Knit's geometry is the plugin's own construction.

PCG_COPPixelate.summary: Pixelates an image into square blocks.
PCG_COPPixelate.description: Divides the image into Size x Size pixel blocks and fills each block with its average color or with the value at the block centre.

outputs.cop: Pixelated image.

params.layers: Space-separated layers to process. Empty processes all layers.
params.mode: Average fills each block with the mean of its pixels; Sample Center uses the single pixel at the block centre.

PCG_COPPlanarInflate.summary: Inflates a mask into a height layer, like a pillow or soap bubble.
PCG_COPPlanarInflate.description:
Pixels of the mask above 0.5 are inflated, and the result is normalized so the highest point equals Height. It is a good starting point for relief, bevelled text and normal maps. An empty mask gives an error.

- **Round**: a circular-arc profile `h = sqrt(2Rd - d^2) / R`, where d is the distance to the boundary and R the largest inner distance. Edges are vertical and the middle is a flat top, like a pillow.
- **Poisson (Soap Bubble)**: solves `laplacian(h) = -1` with h = 0 on the boundary, using a coarse-to-fine Jacobi solver.

outputs.cop: Image with the height layer added.

params.layer: Mask layer. Pixels above 0.5 are inflated.
params.mode: Shape of the profile; see the description.
params.iterations: Poisson mode: Jacobi iterations per resolution level. More gives a more converged result. Round mode ignores it.
params.out_layer: Name of the height layer.

PCG_COPPointGenerate.summary: Adds new points to a point cloud, with the count taken from parameters or from a count attribute.
PCG_COPPointGenerate.description:
The number of new points comes from one of three sources:
- **Parameters**: `Number of Points + Points per Second * Time Step`. Any fractional part is rounded up or down at random according to Seed. The two terms are added, which is this plugin's reading of Houdini's behaviour.
- **Point Attribute**: each source point is copied `floor(count)` times (negative counts give none). Point attributes matching Copy Attributes are copied from the source point; all other attributes of the new points are 0.
- **Detail Attribute**: an integer detail attribute gives the count (floored; the fractional part is not randomized).

The source is `ref` when connected, otherwise `points`. New points sit at the origin unless `P` is copied. If `points` has an `id` attribute, new points continue the numbering from the detail attribute `nextid` (updated afterwards) when present, otherwise from `max(id) + 1`, with a step of the detail attribute `idstep` or 1. With Append Points on, the output is the input points (primitives are discarded) plus the new points.

inputs.points: Point cloud the new points are added to. Optional.
inputs.ref: Optional geometry that supplies the count attribute and the attributes to copy. When not connected, `points` is used.

outputs.points: Points, with the new points appended (or only the new points when Append Points is off).

params.method: Where the point count comes from.
params.number_of_points: Parameters method: number of points to add.
params.points_per_second: Parameters method: rate multiplied by Time Step and added to Number of Points.
params.time_step: Parameters method: time in seconds used with Points per Second. Houdini uses the simulation time step; there is no simulation here, so it is a parameter (default 1/24).
params.rand_seed: Seed for the random rounding of a fractional count.
params.count_attrib: Name of the point or detail attribute that holds the count (Point Attribute and Detail Attribute methods).
params.copy_attribs: Point Attribute method: pattern of point attributes copied from the source points to their new copies.
params.append_points: Keep the input points and append the new points. When off, only the new points are output (with the input's attribute definitions).

PCG_COPPointGenerate.houdini_notes: Time Step is an explicit parameter because the plugin has no simulation time. Houdini's Layer to Points is a different node (see COP Layer To Points).
